items.title: GoodRx $32 Million Class Action Settlement
items.why: Vet data flows with ad and analytics vendors closely in any loyalty or card partnership, given settlement risk.
items.summary_ai: GoodRx agreed to a $32 million class action settlement over alleged sharing of sensitive health data with advertisers from 2017 to 2020.
items.take: Vet data flows with ad and analytics vendors closely in any loyalty or card partnership, given settlement risk.
